facts.fact: FAO says the Gambia GeoLab, a national geospatial platform on Google Earth Engine developed under the ROOTS project, translates satellite data into indicators for monitoring land cover, rice production, mangroves and forests.

GMB.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
Document names no AI system in government administration.
Document names no AI model in a public sector system for Gambia.
Document names no AI model, dataset or AI computing built in Gambia.
